questions.stem: The cosmic microwave background radiation is significant because it is:

options.text: Light emitted by the first stars that formed
Remnant thermal radiation from when the universe cooled enough for atoms to form
Radiation produced by nuclear reactions in the Sun
Radio waves generated by distant pulsars

questions.explanation: The CMB is the remnant thermal radiation from approximately 380,000 years after the Big Bang, when the universe had cooled enough for electrons and protons to combine and form neutral atoms. At this point, photons could travel freely through space, and we detect this radiation today at a temperature of about 2.7 K.
